title: danijar/daydreamer
abstract:
DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning

# DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning Official implementation of the [DayDreamer][paper] algorithm in TensorFlow 2. If you find this code useful, please reference in your paper: [paper]: https://danijar.com/daydreamer/ ## Method DayDreamer learns a world model and an actor critic behavior to train robots from small amounts of experience in the real world, without using simulators. At a high level, DayDreamer consists of two processes. The actor process interacts with the environment and stores experiences into the replay buffer. The learner samples data from the replay buffer to train the world model, and then uses imagined predictions of the world model to train the behavior. To learn from proprioceptive and visual inputs alike, the world model fuses the sensory inputs of the same time step together into a compact discrete representation. A recurrent neural network predicts the sequence of these representations given actions. From the resulting recurrent states and representations, DayDreamer reconstructs its inputs and predicts rewards and episode ends. Given the world model, the actor critic learns farsighted behaviors using on-policy reinforcement learning purely inside the representation space of the world model. For more information: - [Project website](https://danijar.com/project/daydreamer/) - [Research paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.14176.pdf) - [YouTube video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xAXvfVTgqr0) ## Setup ## Instructions To run DayDreamer, open two terminals to execute the commands for the learner bnd the actor in parallel. To view metrics, point TensorBoard at the log directory. For more information, also see the [DreamerV2][dv3] repository. [dv3]: https://github.com/danijar/dreamerv2 A1 Robot: XArm Robot: UR5 Robot: ## Questions Please [open an issue][issues] on Github. [issues]: https://github.com/danijar/daydreamer/issues
abstract_zh: DayDreamer 是一种基于世界模型的算法，它通过少量真实世界经验训练机器人，无需使用模拟器。该方法包含两个并行进程：智能体进程与环境交互并将经验存入回放缓冲区；学习进程从缓冲区采样数据训练世界模型，然后利用世界模型的想象预测来训练行为。世界模型将本体感知和视觉输入融合为紧凑的离散表示，并通过循环神经网络预测动作下的表示序列。基于世界模型，智能体在表示空间内使用同策略强化学习学习远见行为。
tldr_zh: 无需模拟器，DayDreamer 用世界模型从少量真实经验中训练机器人。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：用循环状态空间世界模型把本体感知与视觉输入融合为紧凑离散表征，在想象出的隐空间中用 actor-critic 做纯 on-policy 强化学习，actor 进程持续采集真实经验存入回放缓冲区供 learner 更新世界模型与行为。


# 一、动机

> 真实机器人上学习行为通常依赖仿真器预训练或海量真实交互数据，而仿真到现实的鸿沟和昂贵的真机采样限制了应用。DayDreamer 旨在仅用少量真实世界经验、完全不用仿真器，从零开始在多类物理机器人上学习复杂行为。


# 二、方法

> 用循环状态空间世界模型把本体感知与视觉输入融合为紧凑离散表征，在想象出的隐空间中用 actor-critic 做纯 on-policy 强化学习，actor 进程持续采集真实经验存入回放缓冲区供 learner 更新世界模型与行为。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在 A1 四足机器人上约 1 小时真实数据即学会行走，XArm 约 1 小时学会抓取放置，UR5 约 8 小时从视觉输入学会堆叠；无需仿真器即可在线适应负载变化与外部扰动（分钟级恢复），验证了世界模型在真机小样本学习中的有效性。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限：视觉任务仍需数小时真机数据，世界模型存在想象偏差与超参敏感性，长时程任务的样本效率与稳定性仍待提升。启发：无需仿真器的「世界模型 + 想象训练」范式为具身智能提供了可迁移到多机型、多任务的通用真机学习路径，值得关注其与显式仿真预训练的结合方式。
